title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Smuggling Crime Cases
keywords_en: smuggling; administrative penalty; court's adjudication of smuggling crime cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Smuggling Crime Cases

Fa [2011] No. 163

To: the Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Criminal Law Amendment (VIII) of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Criminal Law Amendment (VIII)) shall come into force on May 1, 2011. The Criminal Law Amendment (VIII) has made substantial revisions to the crime of smuggling. In order to effectively conduct the trial work on smuggling crimes, notice is hereby given on the following issues concerning the application of law in the trial of smuggling crime cases:

1. The Criminal Law Amendment (VIII) has abolished the monetary standard for conviction and sentencing for the crime of smuggling ordinary goods and articles. After the implementation of the Criminal Law Amendment (VIII) and before the promulgation of new judicial interpretations, when trying criminal cases of smuggling ordinary goods and articles, the people's courts in various localities may refer to the monetary standards prescribed by the Criminal Law before the amendment and the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Smuggling (Fa Shi [2000] No. 30).

2. With respect to the circumstances where criminal liability needs to be pursued for smuggling again after having been given two administrative penalties for smuggling within one year, the specific standards for conviction and sentencing may be determined by the people's courts in various localities in light of the specific circumstances of the case and local actual conditions. People's courts in various localities shall, in accordance with law, prudently and steadily handle the application of law and policy in cases, striving for the unity of social effect and legal effect.

3. If new situations and new problems are encountered by people's courts in various localities in the trial of smuggling crime cases, please report them promptly level by level to the Supreme People's Court.

The notice is hereby given.

April 26, 2011
